summary: Phase 5 (affiliate config + Web Push) end-to-end testing PASSED. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase5_affiliate_push.py with 12 new pytest cases covering: GET /api/push/public-key (no auth, returns valid base64url public_key 87 chars), GET /api/affiliate/config (authenticated, returns exactly 25 providers each with provider/name/signup_url/affiliate_id/notes), POST /api/affiliate/config (saves DB ICE -> TEST123, persisted in db.affiliate_config, verified via GET roundtrip), POST with unknown provider returns 400, URL decoration via journey detail (DB ICE provider_link contains &aid=TEST123 / ?aid=TEST123), POST /api/push/subscribe (accepts fake endpoint, returns {ok:true, subscription_id:sha1(endpoint)}), POST /api/push/test (returns {sent:0} when no real browser subs — expected), POST /api/push/notify-delays (returns {checked,notified}), POST /api/push/unsubscribe (marks active=false), /sw.js served 200 with 'push' addEventListener + 'notificationclick' handler, regression on /api/stations/search + /api/stations/count. Full backend regression: 59/59 pytest tests pass (47 prior Phases 1-4 + 12 new Phase 5) in 51.47s with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported from frontend/.env. Frontend Playwright: logged in as demo@trainconnect.eu, verified /tickets shows [data-testid=push-toggle] containing 'VERSPÄTUNGS-ALERTS / PUSH AKTIVIEREN', verified /affiliate shows [data-testid=affiliate-config] with exactly 25 [data-testid^=aff-row-*] rows, filled [data-testid=aff-input-DB ICE] with 'UITEST456', clicked [data-testid=aff-save-DB ICE], reloaded page, confirmed input value persisted as 'UITEST456'. Then called /api/journeys/search + /api/journeys/{id} from browser context — DB ICE provider_link URL = 'https://www.bahn.de/buchung/start?so=Berlin Hauptbahnhof&zo=München Hbf&hd=2026-05-29&aid=UITEST456' confirming live URL decoration with UI-saved aid. /sw.js fetched in-page: status 200, length 3147, contains both 'addEventListener("push"' and 'notificationclick'. Background _delay_poller_loop coroutine scheduled via @app.on_event('startup') — backend supervisor logs show clean startup, no errors. Service worker has both handlers; pywebpush integration imported correctly; VAPID keys present at /app/backend/vapid_private.pem and exposed via /api/push/public-key. No critical or minor bugs found. Iteration 5 carry-over funnel rate now reads 81% (no >100% issue, UI clamp working). Phase 5 is production-ready for the data-flow layer; real push delivery to a real browser is still out of scope (no real subscription).
action_items: Optional: server.py is now 1673 lines (was 1445). Consider splitting affiliate_config + push routes into /app/backend/routes/affiliate.py and /app/backend/routes/push.py for maintainability.

Optional: test_phase3_affiliate.py + test_phase4_stations_ics_pkpass.py crash at collection time when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var is not exported (they use os.environ['REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL']). My new test_phase5 falls back to a default. Recommend updating older tests to dotenv-load frontend/.env or to .get() with fallback. Not blocking — tests pass when env is exported.

Optional: PROVIDER_SIGNUP_URLS dict only covers 19 of the 25 PROVIDER_LINKS keys (missing ČD, MÁV, ZSSK, CFR, BDŽ, HŽPP). For those, /api/affiliate/config falls back to info['home'] (the home URL), which is acceptable but not a real affiliate-signup landing page. User can still enter an affiliate_id for those providers and it will decorate URLs correctly — just the 'signup_url' link points to the company homepage instead of an affiliate program page.

Optional: GET /api/affiliate/config currently exposes any affiliate_id ever saved by any user (single global config doc per provider, keyed only by provider name) — this is fine for a single-admin deploy as described, but if multi-tenant is ever needed, the _id key should include user_id.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:289 resolve_provider_links is now async and queries db.affiliate_config on EVERY call. With ~25 docs this is fast, but on heavy traffic consider an in-process TTL cache (e.g. 60s) to avoid one round-trip per journey detail fetch.

server.py:1497 affiliate_config upsert is keyed by {_id: provider} — globally shared across all users. Documented as 'admin-self-serve' in problem statement, so consistent with design. Confirm with main agent if multi-tenant is ever expected.
server.py:1551-1569 _send_push correctly handles WebPushException 404/410 (gone) by marking subscription inactive — good defensive logic.
server.py:1617 de-dup key uses bucket = max_delay // 5 * 5; means user gets re-notified every 5-min escalation step. Good UX choice.
server.py:1648 @app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in newer FastAPI (≥0.93 prefers lifespan). Works fine in current pin but consider migration in a future cleanup.
Total server.py size is now 1673 lines, above the 700-line guideline. Recommend modular split (routes/, services/) — non-blocking but rising tech debt.
frontend/src/pages.jsx is now 825 lines; same recommendation to split per-page into separate component files.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 implementation is solid.
